jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Cleary Gottlieb is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession. We have fourteen offices in major financial centers around the world, but we operate as a single, integrated global partnership and not a U.S. firm with a network of overseas locations. The firm employs approximately 1,100 lawyers from more than fifty countries.

Since 1946 our lawyers and staff have worked across practices, industries, jurisdictions, and continents to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international. We support every client relationship with intellectual agility, commercial acumen, and a human touch.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue, the Client Account Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing the billing and collection strategy for their teams and in conjunction with firm best practices as well as in accordance with client requirements. This position will (i) collaborate with partners and practice groups leaders along with other Finance teams including the client reporting, strategic pricing and revenue operations teams, (ii) ensure team members are receiving appropriate training and development to respond effectively to partner or client requests, (iii) ensure teams are following client outside counsel guidelines and rates are in-line with client agreements before billing, and (iv) ensure quality and timely reporting for senior management.

Responsibilities:

* Oversee and lead the entire billing and collection process to ensure accurate and timely invoicing and payment of clients for assigned practice groups and/or offices.
* Monitor monthly aging AR reports and take appropriate action to ensure each invoice is paid on time and in full; direct teams to follow-up on underpayments and help with resolution, as needed.
* Performs regular audits of invoices to identify billing errors; identify training or development gaps on team and address.
* Ensure teams have documented for their areas of responsibility their partner requirements, key client requirements (billing, collecting, fee arrangements) in order to allow more streamlined collaboration and coverage among teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing efficiency and accuracy and implement strategies to achieve these goals.
* Review and analyze billing and collection data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
* Respond to billing and AR inquiries.
* Provide monthly updates on unbilled time and AR status, including reports, metrics and presentations.
* Collaborate with internal clients and other finance teams, such as Pricing Operations and ebilling, to ensure accurate client invoices, submission requirements, and reporting.
* Ensure team timely and accurately updates key finance reports (e.g., projection amounts, clear and concise billing or AR comments), to improve reporting for Senior Management.
* Participate in office and/or practice group meetings to understand strategy, challenges, goals of assigned practice groups or offices. Provide reports/updates, as required.
* Manage a team and provide training, development, and support.
* Follow-up with partners to escalate any billing or collection issues or delays.
* Build strong relationships across finance as well as practice groups and partners.
* Ensure adequate coverage during busy times (e.g. year-end, month-end).
* Develop or maintain billing policies and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal best practices, as well as client requirements.
* Provide training on billing best practices, software, reports, tools and any other revenue cycle-related tasks and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in and assigns personnel, as required, for technology testing and software reviews.
* Develop continuous process improvement reviews in order to help shorten revenue cycle timing, improve reporting, and matter intake information. Coordinate with technology teams, as needed.
* Special projects, as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or related fields
* Minimum of 7+ years of relevant billing and client relationship experience at a professional service firm or law firm is required.
* Minimum of 3 years in a manager role
* Proven record of implementing operational and procedural improvements.
* Experience with Aderant is a plus.
* Proficiency with Excel and Word.
* An innovative team player that is willing to pitch in when needed and offer ideas to better the group.
* Flexibility to work evenings and weekends to meet deadlines.

**Critical Competencies for Success:**

* Excellent writing, organizational and communication skills, which is effective at all levels, particularly with attorneys.
* Detail-oriented with a mastery of billing and collections processes, ability to investigate issues and errors, as well as strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, consensus-driven, partnership environment with highly skilled professionals.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $190,000 at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of job-related factors, including skills, education, training, credentials, experience, scope and complexity of role responsibilities, geographic location, and performance. This is an exempt role, meaning it is not eligible for overtime pay.

jobs.title: Dropship Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

**American Exchange Group** is an industry leader in fashion accessory products and brand management. By facilitating distribution to major retailers internationally for their globally recognized brands, custom private label brands, and exclusive licensed brands—including footwear, tech wearables, watches, jewelry, handbags, fashion accessories, home, and beauty—American Exchange Group raises the bar by disrupting the status quo with value and quality, while staying at the forefront of trends.

  

Joining American Exchange Group means being part of a dynamic and diverse team where your contributions drive real impact—and where there’s always room to grow. If you're looking to be part of a company that blends heritage with hustle, we’re excited to meet you.

Visit our website at www.axnygroup.com

  

**Dropship Account Manager**

**Location:** New York City | On-site (4 day in office hybrid)

**Reports to:** Dropship Team Manager

**A****bout the Dropship Business**

American Exchange Group’s dropship business spans a growing portfolio of footwear brands and retail partners. Brands include Aerosoles, Allbirds, Rachel Zoe, and others with retail partners including Macy’s, Nordstrom, DSW, QVC, Belk, and others.

**Position Overview**

The Dropship Account Manager will own the day-to-day business and growth strategy for an assigned portfolio of brands and retail partner accounts, with accountability for sales, profitability, assortment productivity, and account performance. Brand and account assignments may evolve with business needs. This role serves as a primary point of contact for assigned retailer relationships, builds account plans, and turns sales and inventory insights into actions that drive profitable growth.

The ideal candidate brings proven sales and account management experience, strong commercial judgment, and a hands-on understanding of e-commerce and dropship operations. Working across merchandising, planning, marketing, technology, supply chain, wholesale, and direct-to-consumer teams, this person will lead account priorities from opportunity identification through execution and follow-up.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales and Account Ownership**

* Own retailer relationships and account performance within the assigned brand and account portfolio; build trusted partnerships with buyers, merchants, and e-commerce teams.
* Develop and execute plans for assigned brands and accounts to achieve sales and margin goals, including assortment expansion, new product launches, promotional opportunities, and improved product visibility.
* Lead regular retailer business reviews, presenting performance, opportunities, and recommended actions; track commitments through completion.
* Partner with leadership and planning to develop sales forecasts and account targets; monitor results and implement action plans to address gaps.
* Identify and pursue incremental sales opportunities, including expanded placements, seasonal programs, and new account opportunities in partnership with leadership.

**Merchandising and Profitability**

* Analyze sales, margin, sell-through, and inventory by brand, account, style, and SKU to recommend assortment, replenishment, and exit actions.
* Build brand- and account-specific assortment recommendations aligned with each retailer’s customer, inventory availability, and the positioning of each brand.
* Develop promotional and pricing recommendations that balance competitiveness, sales growth, and margin requirements; secure internal approvals and coordinate execution.
* Monitor competitor assortments, pricing, and promotions to identify market trends and product opportunities.

**Account Execution and Cross Functional Leadership**

* Own account readiness for launches and seasonal initiatives, coordinating product setup, content, pricing, inventory availability, and launch timelines.
* Manage retailer portals and coordinate onboarding and integrations with internal teams and external partners.
* Ensure product listings are accurate, complete, and optimized; resolve assortment, content, and availability issues that limit sales.
* Monitor fulfillment, cancellations, shipping timeliness, returns, and chargebacks; partner with operations and supply chain to resolve issues and protect retailer relationships.
* Coordinate priorities across assigned brands and accounts with dropship specialists and cross-functional partners, establishing clear owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
* Maintain account calendars, sales reporting, and action plans; recommend process improvements that support profitable growth and efficient execution.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of relevant sales and account management experience in wholesale, e-commerce, or retail, with direct ownership of customer relationships and sales results.
* Footwear or fashion company experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to grow accounts, identify commercial opportunities, and deliver against sales and profitability goals.
* Experience managing retailer partner accounts and navigating third-party retail platforms or vendor portals; dropship experience strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills, including Excel proficiency and the ability to translate sales, margin, and inventory data into clear recommendations.
* Understanding of retail math, pricing, promotional planning, assortment productivity, and inventory management.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and written and verbal communication skills; comfortable leading retailer meetings and business reviews.
* Highly organized and proactive, with the ability to manage priorities across multiple brands and retail accounts, resolve issues, and drive cross-functional execution.
* Footwear, fashion, or accessories experience preferred.

**Measures of Success**

Success will be measured by sales growth and performance against account targets, margin results, assortment productivity and inventory health, growth in productive listings

**TITLE:** Client Success Manager  
**REPORTING TO:** Client Success Lead  
**LOCATION:** Brooklyn, NY - OR - Marina del Rey, CA

### **Who Is Flip?**

There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one-of-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.

The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling-and-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B+ TAMs each, and we're still early.

We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.

### **What You'll Do**

As a Client Success Manager, you'll work directly with our clients to make sure they are getting measurable value from Flip every day. You'll help launch new customers, support and optimize existing accounts, troubleshoot issues, and become a trusted expert on how our product works within their business.

We are hiring across both our Healthcare and eCommerce/Retail verticals.

* Help customers launch successfully — partner with Sales and Client Success to move customers from signed contract through implementation and go-live.
* Become a product expert quickly — master Flip's platform and understand the workflows, configurations, and integrations that power our customers' experiences.
* Own day-to-day client relationships — serve as a reliable point of contact for customer questions, requests, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization.
* Make the extra test call — proactively test experiences, investigate issues, identify edge cases, and make sure what we deliver actually works for the customer.
* Dig beyond the initial request — learn to understand the "why" behind customer questions and identify the underlying problem they are trying to solve.
* Configure and optimize Flip — make changes within the platform and help customers continuously improve their voice and text experiences.
* Work alongside Product and Engineering — clearly document bugs, feature requests, and customer feedback so internal teams can quickly understand and act on them.
* Use data to understand performance — monitor customer metrics, identify trends, and help communicate the impact Flip is having on their business.
* Build incredible customer relationships — be responsive, organized, thoughtful, and someone our customers genuinely enjoy working with.
* Grow into greater account ownership — develop the technical, strategic, and commercial skills needed to independently manage increasingly complex and enterprise-level customers.

### **What You Bring**

* 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation, Technical Support, Solutions, Account Management, or another client-facing role, ideally within a SaaS or technology company
* Comfortable working directly with B2B clients and managing multiple priorities at once
* Technically curious — you don't need to be an engineer, but you should want to understand how software, integrations, APIs, and data work

* Comfortable working with data and using metrics to understand performance
* Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you follow through, close loops, and don't let client requests disappear
* High aptitude and agency — you learn quickly, take ownership, and use AI and other tools to get to outcomes faster

jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – Websites & Business Automation

Company: Kron AgencyLocation: New York CityWork Setting: In person throughout assigned NYC neighborhoodsCompensation: Commission-based

About Kron Agency

Kron Agency helps local businesses improve how they attract customers, answer calls, schedule appointments, and manage everyday customer requests.

Our services include professional websites, automated voice receptionists, online booking systems, customer-service bots, lead-capture tools, and custom business automations.

Our voice receptionists can use natural-sounding technology such as ElevenLabs. Each system is customized around the business it serves. It can answer incoming calls, speak naturally with customers, book appointments, answer approved questions, collect information, transfer calls, and complete tasks based on the company’s workflow.

For example, a system built for a dental office could:

* Answer calls during busy hours or after the office closes
* Schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments
* Answer questions about hours, location, services, and accepted insurance
* Collect new-patient contact information
* Send appointment confirmations and reminders
* Transfer important calls to the correct employee
* Follow the dental office’s approved call script and procedures

Similar systems can be customized for salons, barbershops, auto repair shops, restaurants, contractors, law offices, real estate companies, medical offices, spas, and other local businesses.

Assigned Routes and Leads

Kron Agency has already identified more than 125 potential business leads throughout New York City.

Sales representatives receive organized routes containing selected businesses within specific neighborhoods. Each route provides an ordered list of locations to visit, allowing representatives to focus on meeting business owners and making sales.

Representatives must complete their assigned routes, record the result of every visit, and follow up with interested businesses.

Services You Will Sell

Depending on the business’s needs, representatives may sell:

* Professional business websites
* Website redesigns and upgrades
* Automated voice receptionists
* Phone-answering and call-routing systems
* Appointment-booking systems
* Website chat and customer-support bots
* Lead-capture and customer-intake systems
* Automated confirmations and reminders
* Customer follow-up systems
* Business-specific workflow automations
* Complete website, phone, and booking packages

Representatives do not need coding or website-development experience. Kron Agency will provide demonstrations, service information, sales materials, and training on how to explain each solution.

Responsibilities

* Visit local businesses using your assigned NYC route
* Ask to speak with the owner, manager, or decision-maker
* Introduce Kron Agency and explain our website and automation services
* Learn how the business currently handles calls, bookings, customer questions, and new leads
* Identify problems such as missed calls, outdated websites, scheduling difficulties, lost customers, and slow follow-up
* Recommend services that match the business’s actual needs
* Demonstrate our websites, voice receptionists, booking tools, and automated systems
* Explain the service clearly without using complicated technical language
* Collect accurate contact information from interested business owners
* Schedule demonstrations and follow-up conversations
* Follow up consistently and work toward closing sales
* Record every visit as unavailable, declined, interested, follow-up required, demonstration scheduled, or sale closed
* Submit regular updates on completed routes, conversations, follow-ups, and sales
* Represent Kron Agency professionally and honestly

What We Need From Our Representatives

* Confidence approaching local businesses in person
* Strong communication and listening skills
* Ability to understand a business’s problems before offering a solution
* Reliability and the ability to complete assigned routes
* Professional appearance and behavior
* Ability to explain modern technology in simple language
* Comfort demonstrating websites and voice systems
* Strong follow-up and sales-closing habits
* A smartphone with reliable internet access
* Ability to walk and travel throughout assigned NYC neighborhoods
* Accurate recordkeeping and consistent reporting
* Motivation to work independently and earn through commission

Previous experience in outside sales, door-to-door sales, software sales, telecommunications, digital marketing, advertising, or business services is helpful. Training will be provided.

Compensation

This is a commission-based sales position. Representatives earn commission for successfully closing website projects, voice-receptionist systems, booking solutions, automation services, and complete business packages.

Commission details will be explained before onboarding.

Ideal Candidate

This position is a good fit for someone who is outgoing, dependable, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently. The ideal candidate enjoys meeting business owners, learning how their operations work, and showing them practical ways to capture more customers and reduce missed opportunities.

Knowledge of New York City neighborhoods and the ability to speak multiple languages are advantages.

How to Apply

Please submit:

* Full name
* Phone number
* Current borough or neighborhood
* Previous sales experience
* Languages spoken
* Weekly availability
* Ability to travel throughout New York City
* A short explanation of why you would be a good fit for Kron Agency

Pay: $250.00 - $600.00 per day

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Apparel Packaging Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 1954 on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, Gold Medal International (GMI) has established itself as one of the leading hosiery and accessories companies in the industry. GMI designs, sources, and manufactures wholesale socks and accessories for a customer base ranging from small independent stores to the most prestigious department stores in the country.

Creating great employee experiences has always been a priority at GMI. We know first-hand that when we take care of our employees, they will take care of our customers, and we strive for this every day.

Through our best times and challenging times, we remain inspired by the resilience of our team. Leadership recognizes the value in providing workplace flexibility, and our hybrid-remote work model has had a tremendous impact on the quality of life for our employees. GMI commits to maintaining high levels of customer service, and we take pride in our reputation for treating everyone like family.

About The Role

We are seeking a part-time Packaging Production Coordinator who will report to the Vice President of Sourcing in the New York metropolitan area. This is a regular part-time, hourly role scheduled for 24 – 30 hours per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, working on site in our NYC office, with extra hours available during our peak production season. You will be the final check that our packaging, test reports, and Top of Production (TOP) samples all line up before product ships, and you will take key follow-up work off our Production Managers' plates.

About You

You are the person who notices when a UPC scans as “Navy” but the sock in your hand is charcoal. You like checking details, and you don't mind checking them twice. You write clear, direct emails, including to factory partners overseas, and you know when to fix something yourself and when to flag it for the team. You can manage several open items at once within a part-time schedule, and you keep good records so nothing slips between your workdays.

What You Will Do

Our Packaging Production Coordinator protects the quality of every item that reaches our customers. You will compare test reports, care labels, and packaging layouts to make sure they match, confirm that UPCs and lot numbers scan correctly, and approve TOP samples. You will also support our Production Managers by tracking test reports in the WIP (Work in Progress) report, maintaining shipping material samples, and preparing cost sheets and documents so orders keep moving.

Packaging Review and Approval

* Review each test report to confirm it is valid and current, and that it lists the correct brands and styles.
* Check packaging layouts against the test report and care labels so fiber content and wash instructions match.
* Review the factory's digital packaging proof against the file we sent, confirming fonts, copy, and every requested detail carried over before final print.
* Scan UPCs to confirm they read correctly and pull up the right style, color, and product information.
* Confirm the Country of Origin (COO) has been updated on all packaging.
* Confirm all required testing in the PO testing protocol has been completed and passed.
* Approve TOP samples by confirming final packaging matches all testing and that UPCs and lot numbers scan correctly.

Test Reports and WIP Follow-Up

* Receive test reports through the testing distribution list, file them, and begin review.
* Flag any callouts or failures to the Production team, who lead corrections with the factory.
* When a brand or style is listed incorrectly, email the factory with the correction and copy the distribution list so Production stays informed.
* Monitor and follow up on the test report portion of the WIP report.
* Time final checks so packaging and test results are reviewed together, avoiding duplicate work.

Production Team Support

* Maintain approval samples of shipping materials, such as carton cuttings, polybags, and customer-specific UPCs.
* Monitor the missing DIMS (carton dimensions) report to confirm dimensions meet our carton requirements and are submitted on time.
* Create cost sheets so purchase orders can be issued.
* Check documents so import folders can be entered.
* Assist with inspection report approvals during peak season.
* Manage sample bins and empty them once TOP samples are approved.

What You Will Need

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Experience in apparel, accessories, or consumer product production, packaging, or quality control.
* Working knowledge of test reports, care labels, and UPC barcodes, or the ability to learn them quickly.
* Ability to prioritize and manage time effectively within a part-time schedule.
* Clear, professional written communication, including email with overseas factories.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel and the entire Office 365 application.
* Experience with PLM or ERP systems is a plus.
* Comfortable working on site with a team that includes hybrid-remote colleagues.
* Availability for additional hours during peak season.

Why You’ll Love Working at GMI

For more than 70 years, GMI has been a family-style company. We take care of our people, and they take care of our customers.

* Set part-time schedule: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, 8 hours a day (24 hours a week) in our NYC office, with Mondays and Fridays off.
* 5 days of paid time off: 40 hours of PTO that covers both vacation and sick time. It is available on January 1 (prorated in your first year), and you can use it right away.
* Hands-on experience: see how product moves from factory testing to the retail shelf, working alongside an experienced Production team.
* Growth: a pay review every year and support to keep learning.

Our Values

* Honest: we’re open and fair, and we keep our word.
* People-First: we treat employees, customers, and partners with respect.
* Proactive: we spot problems early and act.
* Flexible: we support work-life balance and adapt to what customers need.

Panther is unlocking the tremendous biological power of our skin, delivering efficacious, shelf-stable treatments directly to customers. SmartPatches enable effective, tech-enabled customer experiences, and our AI platform provides valuable insights for improved patient outcomes and the development of even better treatments. SmartPatches are affordable to manufacture and distribute, and easy to apply, resulting in greater access and market expansion. Panther is growing quickly, and our executive team needs more hands to keep everything running smoothly. As our Part-Time Executive Assistant, you will work closely with our Executive Assistant to the CEO to manage scheduling, travel, expenses, and events for the executive team, and to keep our NYC office running well. * Schedule meetings and manage calendars for members of the executive team, in coordination with the Executive Assistant to the CEO.

jobs.title: Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

KNAPP brings new technology to warehouse automation.

The KNAPP Group is a global provider of intelligent automation solutions for intralogistics and manufacturing, specializing in the sectors healthcare, fashion/apparel, general retail, food retail, industry and service. We live and breathe automation. We, more than 8,000 employees of the KNAPP Group across over 60 locations worldwide, shaping the future-oriented intralogistics industry, are dedicated to making complexity simple.

One of KNAPP’s primary goals is to use continuous innovation to drive warehouse automation forward, always with the specific needs of the customers in mind. KNAPP Group’s unrelenting development activity is evident in everything from automated order picking systems and continuing refinement of container handling technology to its state-of-the-art, industry leading software solutions.

**WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily procurement operations through purchase request processing, purchase order management, supplier communication, goods receiving, invoice reconciliation, and general procurement administration.  
The role ensures timely and accurate procurement transactions while maintaining compliance with company policies, project requirements, and financial controls.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Procurement Administration**

* Process Purchase Order Requests (PORs) and review submissions for completeness and accuracy.
* Create, manage, and modify Purchase Orders in SAP.
* Request quotations from suppliers as required.
* Support supplier onboarding and maintenance of vendor master data.
* Coordinate order confirmations and delivery schedules.
* Assist internal stakeholders with procurement-related inquiries.
* Maintain procurement documentation and records.

**Receiving & Invoice Processing**

* Receive goods and services in SAP.
* Perform invoice matching and reconciliation between Purchase Orders, receipts, and supplier invoices.
* Resolve discrepancies related to pricing, quantities, deliveries, and invoicing.
* Support processing within SAP, Basware, AFI, and other approved systems.
* Assist with month-end and year-end procurement activities.

**Supplier & Stakeholder Support**

* Communicate with suppliers regarding quotations, orders, deliveries, and invoice issues.
* Support issue resolution between suppliers and internal customers.
* Maintain professional supplier relationships.
* Escalate supply or service concerns when appropriate.

**Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, approval workflows, and financial controls.
* Support Lean Waiver and approval processes when required.
* Maintain accurate procurement data and documentation.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and increased efficiency.
* Support internal and external audits as required.

**Area-Specific Responsibilities**

**Project Procurement**

In addition to the core responsibilities listed above:

* Support procurement activities for customer projects from project launch through final completion.
* Process project-specific material and subcontractor purchase orders.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Engineers, Logistics, and Project Procurement personnel.
* Track supplier deliveries and project procurement milestones.
* Support expediting efforts to mitigate schedule risks.
* Maintain project procurement documentation and reporting.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**

* Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, or a related discipline preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, logistics, receiving, or administrative functions.
* Experience with SAP or comparable ERP systems preferred.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and customer-service mindset.

**Working Conditions and Environment:**

* Professional office environment.
* Occasional overtime as required.
* Occasional domestic travel.
* Authorization to work in the United States.
* Passport or ability to obtain a passport.
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, communicate, and use standard office equipment for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift or move materials up to 50 pounds.

**WHAT YOU WILL GET**

* 2 remote days per week
* Half day Fridays
* A beautiful new, state-of-the-art, office complex in Kennesaw, GA
* Industry competitive compensation
* Great benefits with better than average employer contributions, including health, dental, vision, life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short & Long Term Disability and more!
* 401k with a very generous employer match and no vesting!
* Paid Vacation & Holidays
* Profit Sharing
* Paid Parental Leave
* Subsidized Daycare
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Pet Insurance
* Subsidized food delivery
* Monthly celebrations
* Quarterly employee events
* Corporate Social Responsibility including recycling, sustainability and volunteering

*KNAPP is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other basis protected by law.*

jobs.description:
Pharmaceutical Hybrid Account Manager - Women’s Healthcare
  
Southeast Region
  
  
Ready to take your pharmaceutical sales career beyond the phone?
  
  
EXCITING TEAM EXPANSION WITH EXELTIS PHARMACEUTICALS! (DIRECT HIRE WITH EXELTIS)
  
  
Be part of the Top Talent Team at Exeltis! Exeltis is seeking motivated Hybrid Account Managers with a successful background in pharmaceutical/biopharma virtual / inside sales who are ready to step into the field and take their sales impact to the next level!
  
  
If you’re a results-driven sales professional with proven success driving sales over the phone, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for building strong customer relationships, this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for. With flexibility to travel up to 50%, you’ll have the chance to expand your reach, connect with customers face-to-face, and grow your career in the field.
  
  
Ready to turn your inside sales success into field sales success? We want to hear from you! This is a full-time opportunity with Exeltis Pharmaceuticals to bring innovative solutions where there is a need for strategic account coverage. Go to View Openings & Apply Here to view the job and apply.
  
  
Why Exeltis?
  
  
Expect Extraordinary when you join Exeltis! Our team insists on – and delivers on – Extraordinary in everything we do. At Exeltis, everyone is made to feel welcome and everyone’s ideas count, because we believe in caring for and supporting our people. When you join the Exeltis family, you’ll find yourself collaborating with extraordinary colleagues from all walks of life, and you’ll be supported with opportunities for growth and learning at every stage of your career
  
  
Exeltis offers a competitive benefits package including Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, Disability and Life Insurance, Generous PTO, Emerging Leader Development Program, as well as a robust Wellness Program and 401K plan.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you will act as the primary customer contact within an assigned territory by creating demand and executing sales & marketing strategies in the promotion of key products in Exeltis’ Women’s Healthcare portfolio. You’ll be calling on OB/GYN’s and Family Practice accounts. The Hybrid Account Manager will spend much of their time utilizing virtual (phone-based) interactions while also traveling out of state up to 50% per month within the assigned region to make in-person field calls on Super Target accounts.
  
  
Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Drive strategic product promotion by executing targeted sales initiatives for Exeltis Pharmaceuticals’ Women’s Health portfolio through phone-based outreach, virtual meetings, and in-person field engagement.
* Utilizes knowledge, critical thinking, and dialogue skills to deliver meaningful customer experiences that result in satisfaction and loyalty.
* Anticipates, identifies, and appropriately addresses HCP and account objections, questions, and concerns, utilizing all appropriate resources and information, providing timely and effective solutions.
* Host virtual meetings to educate accounts on product usage and patient profiles.
* Meet or exceed daily and monthly call targets while efficiently managing administrative tasks.
* Maintain detailed records in the CRM system per company policy.
* Remain compliant with all company & FDA regulations and policies while carrying out responsibilities.
* Plans and schedules meetings and lunch programs at accounts for the week deployed in the field.
* Travels to Super Target accounts to educate on product usage and patient profiles.
* Meet or exceed sales target goals for territory.

Qualifications for the role
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Minimum of 2 years of phone-based sales experience, pharmaceutical/biopharma is a plus.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Self-starter with the ability to work independently and adapt quickly.
* Women’s Health sales experience is plus.
* Strong digital communication and CRM proficiency.
* Excellent interpersonal, listening, and presentation skills.
* Organized, self-motivated, and able to manage a remote territory effectively.
* Skilled in using phone and video technologies to build relationships.
* Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.
* Must be willing and able to travel out of state with overnight stays approximately one week per month to cover Super Target accounts across the multi-state Region and/or attend conferences.

Exeltis Overview
  
  
Exeltis is an independent, family-owned women’s healthcare company passionately committed to serving patients, making a contribution to society and caring for the wellbeing of our employees. As a company, we offer an innovative portfolio, delivering unique solutions to real problems in women’s health. Our vision is of a world where women are empowered to lead their healthiest lives. By supporting women’s health at every stage of life, from fertility, healthy pregnancies, and contraception to menopause. To learn more about Exeltis and our products visit, http://exeltisusa.com/.
  
  
If you have a proven record of success and the desire to have a positive impact in the healthcare field, we want to hear from you. Apply at, Job Openings - ImpactBio
  
  
Exeltis is an equal opportunity employer M/F/V/D. We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only qualified candidates will be considered.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Lube Squad

Lube Squad is a leading distributor of automotive lubricants, chemicals, and related products, proudly serving dealerships, quick lube centers, automotive repair shops, parts stores, and commercial businesses. With an extensive product line, reliable distribution network, and commitment to exceptional customer service, we have built our reputation on quality, flexibility, and integrity.

As an authorized distributor of Everest, REX, ROWE, and iLast products, Lube Squad of Atlanta provides high-quality lubricants and automotive products for passenger vehicles, commercial trucks, industrial equipment, and agricultural machinery.

Our extensive distribution capabilities, competitive product offerings, and dependable delivery service allow us to provide customers with the products and support they need to keep their businesses running efficiently.

Position Overview

We are seeking a **motivated, results-driven Outside Sales Account Manager** to join our growing Atlanta team.

This position is responsible for **building and maintaining strong customer relationships, managing and growing existing accounts, and actively pursuing new business opportunities to expand our customer base and increase sales.**

The ideal candidate understands that successful sales go beyond acquiring new customers. Building long-term partnerships, providing consistent follow-up, understanding customer needs, and delivering exceptional service are essential to this role.

We are looking for a self-motivated professional who takes ownership of their accounts, enjoys working directly with customers, and is committed to driving sustainable sales growth.

Key Responsibilities

**Account Management & Customer Relationships**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts, developing and maintaining strong, long-term business relationships.
* Conduct regular in-person customer visits to understand business needs, provide product recommendations, and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Proactively manage existing accounts to encourage customer retention, identify additional sales opportunities, and increase account revenue.
* Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, concerns, and service-related issues.
* Work closely with internal teams to ensure customer expectations are met and issues are resolved efficiently.

**Business Development & Sales Growth**

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Generate leads, prospect potential customers, and establish new business relationships.
* Present and promote Lube Squad's extensive line of automotive lubricants, chemicals, and related products.
* Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve individual sales goals and expand market presence.
* Negotiate pricing and sales agreements in accordance with company guidelines.

**Sales Performance & Reporting**

* Meet or exceed established sales goals while maintaining strong customer relationships.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer visits, sales activities, opportunities, and account interactions.
* Monitor customer purchasing trends to identify opportunities for increased sales and account growth.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and product developments.
* Collaborate with management and internal departments to support sales initiatives and overall business objectives.

Qualifications

* Previous outside sales or account management experience preferred, ideally within the automotive, lubricant, aftermarket parts, or related distribution industries.
* Proven ability to develop new business while maintaining and growing existing customer accounts.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing customer relationships and sales activities independently.
* Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales goals.
* Strong customer service skills with a commitment to building lasting business relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize responsibilities, and follow through on commitments.
* Knowledge of automotive lubricants, chemicals, or related products is a plus.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
* Fluency in English required; Spanish bilingual skills are a plus.

Compensation & Opportunities

Lube Squad offers:

* Competitive base salary plus commission.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* An established product portfolio featuring recognized automotive lubricant brands.
* A supportive team environment focused on customer satisfaction and business growth.
* The opportunity to develop and manage long-term customer relationships within a growing organization.

Join Our Team!

At Lube Squad, we believe strong customer relationships are the foundation of our success. We are looking for individuals who take pride in their work, value customer service, and are motivated to grow their accounts and contribute to the company's continued success.

**If you are a driven sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing new business, and making a lasting impact, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Lube Squad team!**

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Onboarding Specialist**

**Atlanta, GA | Client Success**

**About Injury Bridge**

Injury Bridge is a rapidly growing virtual care company that operates at the intersection of patient care and the personal injury ecosystem. We partner with healthcare providers and law firms nationwide to improve access to care and deliver better outcomes for patients throughout the recovery journey.

Our approach connects key stakeholders through coordinated services, rapid access to care, and consistent documentation, helping streamline processes and create a better experience for both patients and partners. We are a results-driven, collaborative organization that values accountability, execution, and continuous growth.

**The Role**

We are seeking an Onboarding Specialist to be the first point of contact for our law firm partners once they sign with Injury Bridge. You will take the handoff from our Business Development Managers and guide each new firm from signed agreement to fully active account: portal set up, team trained, and first patients referred.

This role is ideal for someone who is part trainer, part project manager, and part relationship builder. You will run onboarding sessions with firm attorneys and staff, learn how every department works so you can answer questions with confidence, and stay with each account until it is up and running across our full suite of services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the handoff from sales to onboarding, partnering with Business Development Managers so every new firm has a smooth transition

* Schedule and lead onboarding calls and training sessions, often with multiple attorneys and staff, showing firms how to use our portal and access our services

* Set up and configure each firm's portal so it is ready to use before their onboarding call

* Introduce new firms to our full suite of products and services so they are activated across the scorecard, not just one offering

* Shadow each internal department to understand our processes end to end and answer firm questions accurately and confidently

* Provide follow-up support after the first call until each account is fully active and referring patients

* Track onboarding status, activity, and notes in HubSpot

* Spot recurring questions or friction points and share feedback to improve the onboarding process and materials

**What success looks like:**

* **First 30–60–90 days:** shadowed every department, running onboarding calls on your own, and HubSpot current for every account you own.

* **Speed to activation:** new firms move from signed to fully set up and referring within a consistent, predictable timeframe.

* **Full-scorecard adoption:** firms you onboard are using all of our products, not just one.

* **Seamless handoffs:** sales reps trust you with their new firms, and nothing falls through the cracks between teams.

* **Strong first impressions:** firms come out of onboarding confident in the portal, and early support questions decline over time.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2+ years of experience in client onboarding, implementation, account management, or customer success

* Experience in personal injury, legal services, or healthcare is strongly preferred

* Confident presenter who can lead engaging, informative sessions for groups, virtually or in person

* Comfortable learning and teaching software platforms; CRM experience (HubSpot preferred)

* Highly organized, able to manage many accounts at different stages at once

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a service-first mindset

* Self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive base salary plus a performance bonus

* Opportunity to join a high-growth company with strong market momentum

* Supportive, team-oriented culture

* Cross-departmental learning and career development and advancement opportunities

Pay: $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Sandy Springs, GA 30342 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**SUMMARY of Used Truck Sales**

Vanguard Truck Centers is looking for the proactive Used Truck sales person that is passionate about growing sales and has a passion for growing and developing within the company. This position is responsible for selling used heavy and medium duty trucks while achieving and maintaining appropriate levels of gross profit, unit count objective, and customer satisfaction.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES of Used Truck Sales**

Essential Duties include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Satisfies the transportation needs of used-truck Sales purchasers.
* Approaches, greets, and offers assistance or direction to any customer who enters the dealership showroom or sales lot.
* Assists customers in selecting a vehicle by asking questions and listening carefully to their responses. Suggests alternative tractors/truck if necessary.
* Exhibits a high level of commitment to customer satisfaction.
* Understands the terminology of the truck business and keeps abreast of changes in product technology, incoming inventory, features, accessories, etc.
* Provides thorough product information and demonstration to all prospects.
* Offers test drives to all prospects. Follows dealership procedure to obtain proper identification from customer before test drive begins.
* Closes used truck deals.
* Writes complete and accurate sales orders, secures deposits, and processes paperwork in accordance with established dealership policies.
* Appraises used trucks when necessary.
* Collects accurate and complete financial data on customers when necessary.
* Delivers used trucks, explaining used truck warranty, as-is disclosure statement, and service policies.
* Utilizes dealership prospect development and follow-up system.
* Uses all reasonable methods of prospecting for used truck customers on a daily basis by telephone.
* Prepares and turns in to the UTM outside sales call reports, listing who was called, what units were quoted, and units available for sale, if applicable.
* Knows and understands the federal, state, and local laws which govern retail commercial truck sales.
* Establishes personal income goals that are consistent with dealership standards of productivity, and devises a strategy to meet those goals.
* Knows and understands equity and values, and is able to explain depreciation to the customer.
* Turns 100% of closed deals to F&I manager and presents properly completed paperwork (i.e. insurance information, trade title, etc.)
* Works with the service department to ensure that trucks are properly reconditioned on schedule.
* Prepares sold trucks for delivery (i.e. cleans truck, ensures reconditioning has been completed properly, and ensures all features are operational) prior to customers arrival.
* Delivers trucks to customers, ensuring that the customer understands the trucks operation features, warranty, and paperwork.
* Introduces customers to service department personnel to emphasize to them the quality and efficiency of service repairs and maintenance available in the dealerships service department.
* Follows up on all post-delivery items, tag/title work, we-owes, and special requests to be sure that all customer expectations are met.
* Maintains an owner follow-up system that encourages repeat and referral business and contributes to customer satisfaction (Cal-Pro)
* Attends sales meetings.
* Helps with the used truck inspection process.
* Maintains a professional business appearance.
* Reviews and analyzes actions at the end of each day, week, month, and year to determine how to better utilize time and plans more effectively.

* Support the Sales organization with technical solutions, proposal preparation, and commercial insights

* Maintain strong knowledge of Kelvion’s products and services to identify the best solutions for customers
* Support training and collaboration with Kelvion’s Strategic Partners, including product training and software demonstrations
* Consult with Global Solutions Engineering teams to coordinate technically complex solutions
* Support Account Executives and Marketing with customer contact campaigns by phone, email, and occasional in-person events
* Maintain regular communication with key accounts and Strategic Partners to support effective project execution
* Prepare and analyze data for monthly or quarterly business reviews with top Strategic Partners and key accounts.
* Provide quotations and support materials that align with Kelvion’s strategic selling plans
* Manage internal and external communication documentation using Kelvion’s CRM tools

Proactively grow and maintain revenue within designated accounts and target markets by expanding share of wallet with existing customers and converting new opportunities into Kelvion business.

* Proposal turnaround time.
* Quote activity, hit rate, and quote-to-order success.
* Order intake revenue.
* Gross margin.
* Customer engagement and customer-related activity.
* Days sales outstanding.
* Payment terms.

**Position Description**

The Sales Development Representative’s primary objective is to develop the necessary new business development skills for B2B outbound prospecting and build the foundation to become a successful sales consultant. The initial goal in this role is to gain acceptance and agreement from prospective businesses to set up initial meetings with our revenue-producing sales consultants who then drive the process forward. Reporting to the B&I Sales Development Manager, the role will pursue a high volume of outbound suspects who are sourced through marketing efforts and partnerships with our service line sales leaders. The role will have access to data-driven systems such as Salesforce, SalesLoft, DemandBase, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other productivity tools to help you succeed.

* Utilize effective outbound calling strategies, effective email messaging, and social selling techniques developed in collaboration with Marketing and Sales Management to secure first appointments with prospective businesses.

* Evaluate and qualify interest by engaging and navigating phone conversations.
* Overcome objections, engage with prospects in conversations, and gain their acceptance to connect with our sales consultants.
* Initiate sales discussions between sales consultants and decision-makers.
* Document findings in customer relationship management (CRM) software.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospect’s interactions and sales activities in the CRM system.
* Log appropriate follow up activities to stay connected with prospective companies and maintain business relevance.
* Meet and exceed targets for scheduled meetings and conversion rates.
Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, value differentiators, and competition to enhance inbound and outbound prospecting efforts.

* A bachelor's degree in Risk Management Insurance, Sales, Business, or a related field.
* Strong drive to compete and succeed in a fast-paced sales environment.

* Excellent communication skills with an ability to connect with people in a short amount of time.

Relentlessly curious mindset and a willingness to learn about Advisory Services.

* Months 10-18: Transition to a B&I service line, obtain licensing, service line specific training and coaching, and service line sales process training.
* Months 19+: Continuing to work toward sales producer position.

As a Business Development Representative aka, Strategic Growth Partner (SGP) at Compass International Holdings, you are the face of the company and the engine of our market expansion, directly responsible for driving net-new pipeline for our Strategic Growth Team. In its simplest form, you will educate our agent community on the benefits and importance of contributing to the Strategic Growth of Compass International Holdings, identifying who in their network of prospective agents should be introduced to our closing team.

SGPs are the future of the Strategic Growth organization. In addition to the direct impact this role has as a partner to the Strategic Growth Managers (SGMs) in the market, you will ultimately be working toward the goal of becoming an SGM yourself. From onboarding all the way through a formal SGP-to-SGM training program, your focus will be on developing the skills and knowledge that line a direct path into a closing sales position within an incredibly driven, high-performing team.

**What You’ll Do**

* Generate new business opportunities to build a sales pipeline through strategic inbound and outbound efforts.
* Outreach directly to prospective agents that fit our ideal persona via cold-calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns, and other methods.
* Articulate our value proposition (technology, marketing, culture, and growth) and handle objections to create qualified opportunities in your market.
* Partner with Agents to identify referral opportunities and seamlessly transition them to a Strategic Growth Manager for full-cycle closing.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Growth Managers and Team Leaders to develop successful prospecting strategies, adding value to each SGM’s sales process.
* Drive active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow-up communications.
* Analyze addressable markets in emergent geographies and create demand for our disruptive technology.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to create new processes and refine existing ones through innovative thinking.
* Document all activities within our CRM, maintaining flawless data management.

**What This Role Offers**

* A formal SGP-to-SGM training program designed to fast-track your career into a closing sales position.
* Direct partnership and mentorship from top-performing Strategic Growth Managers and market leaders.
* A highly collaborative environment where you can actively innovate on processes and outbound strategies.
* Operate with a "glass-half-full" mentality, making a tangible impact on the company's market expansion.

**How You’ll Be Measured** This role is measured by pipeline generation and the volume of qualified opportunities successfully created for the Strategic Growth Managers.

* Highly organized with the ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail-demanding functional responsibilities.

**Compensation** The base pay range for this position is $38.46–$43.27 per hour ($80,000–$90,000 annualized); with an annual target bonus of $10K-$15K and uncapped bonus potential. We provide a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location.

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

### **Please see Special Instructions for more details.**

Employment in this role may be contingent upon extramural funding and successful performance and may be terminated or reduced in percentage of appointment if such funding is not secured or ceases to be available.

  

The Research Coordinator manages the day-to-day regulatory and data operations of federally funded clinical trials. This specialized role focuses heavily on maintaining daily operations and management, National Institutes of Health (NIH) compliance, managing Institutional Review Board (IRB) life cycles, and building data collection infrastructure within REDCap. The ideal candidate ensures all research activities adhere to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), institutional policies, and federal laws.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage IRB Operations: Draft, submit, and track initial IRB applications, protocol amendments, continuing reviews, and adverse event reports.

* Maintain NIH Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to NIH grants policy statements, public access policies, clinicaltrial.gov registrations, and data management and sharing (DMS) plans.

* Develop REDCap Databases: Design, build, test, and maintain secure electronic case report forms (eCRFs), longitudinal instruments, and automated surveys within REDCap.

* Oversee Documentation: Establish and audit Regulatory Binder files, including delegation of authority logs, protocol training records, and signed informed consent forms.

* Coordinate Data Management: Coordinate clinical and biological assessments. Monitor data entry quality, resolve data queries, export datasets for biostatisticians, and ensure HIPAA compliance for protected health information (PHI).

* Support Site Audits: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal quality assurance monitors, NIH program officers, and safety monitoring boards during regulatory audits.

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in public health, Life Sciences, Clinical Research, or a highly structured administrative discipline (Master’s preferred).

* Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of direct coordination experience in an academic, clinical, or industry research setting.
* Proven experience in community engagement and logistics related to scheduling evidence-based interventions, specifically within randomized controlled trials (RCTs).

Leadership/Management: Experience in managing diverse teams, including health educators, navigators, research assistants, and students.

* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in REDCap database development (e.g., branching logic, calculated fields, user rights management).

jobs.title: Account Manager, Strategic Partner Accounts
jobs.description:
At Mintel, we help businesses understand people, markets, and what comes next. As a global market intelligence agency, our understanding of consumers, innovation, and markets gives clients the clarity to act and the confidence to lead. With more than 50 years of expertise, we combine the real-world understanding of our experts with advanced technology to uncover patterns, anticipate change, and help organizations make smarter decisions.

As an Account Manager within the Strategic Partner Accounts team, you are responsible for driving client retention, growth, and value realization across a portfolio of global enterprise clients - including strategic anchor accounts, which span multiple business units, regions, and buying centers operating under a single global relationship.

This is an individual contributor role with full ownership of renewal and expansion revenue targets. You will deliver proactive, high-touch engagement, ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes and continue to invest in their partnership with Mintel. On the most complex accounts, this includes managing risk and opportunity independently across multiple internal client stakeholders and organizational layers, rather than a single point of contact.

You will work in close partnership with Global Account Directors and Lead Client Partners in a team-selling environment to align client value with commercial success.

**This is a Hybrid position based in Chicago**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Renewal Ownership & Commercial Performance**

* Own a defined portfolio renewal and growth target
* Develop and execute account-specific renewal strategies based on demonstrated client value
* Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and pipeline visibility
* Deliver against retention and revenue expansion targets
* Track and defend renewal health at the sub-account level (business unit / region) as well as in aggregate, since a single global relationship can mask fragmented risk within individual divisions

**Contract Negotiation & Commercial Execution**

* Lead renewal and contract negotiations, including procurement engagement
* Build and present compelling commercial narratives linked to ROI and client outcomes
* Manage objections and position Mintel's value effectively
* Close renewal and expansion deals to achieve target performance
* Navigate formalized, RFP-driven procurement processes and multi-year MSA/SOW structures typical of large, multi-divisional global organizations, including competitive vendor reviews

**Growth Opportunity Identification**

* Identify upsell and consulting opportunities through structured discovery
* Partner with Account Directors and Client Partners to convert opportunities into revenue
* Leverage client data and engagement signals to drive account growth
* Independently identify and coordinate opportunities that surface in different parts of the client organization (e.g., category management, innovation/R&D, e-commerce, sustainability), each with distinct insight needs and separate budget owners

**Success Planning & Value Delivery**

* Own end-to-end Success Plans aligned to client business objectives
* Define and track measurable outcomes and ROI
* Drive adoption strategies to ensure sustained engagement and value realization

**Client Engagement & Adoption**

* Deliver proactive, structured engagement plans across assigned accounts
* Facilitate training sessions and workshops to drive platform adoption
* Build and maintain strong, multi-level stakeholder relationships
* On accounts with layered global / regional / local structures, coordinate a consistent cadence and message across a wide network of individual contacts so the relationship stays coherent

**Client Health & Risk Management**

* Monitor account health using usage, engagement, and feedback signals
* Identify churn risks and implement mitigation plans
* Maintain consistent executive-level communication
* Monitor and reconcile health signals that may vary significantly across business units or regions within a single account

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with internal teams (Insights, Product, Consulting, Operations) to deliver client outcomes
* Contribute to coordinated global account strategies
* Act as the internal orchestration point across multiple Mintel service lines engaged concurrently on different parts of the same account, ensuring internal teams present a unified front

**Success Measures**

Success in this role is evaluated through:

* Portfolio retention rate (%)
* Net revenue retention (NRR) / revenue growth
* Renewal and expansion revenue achievement vs. target
* Client adoption and engagement metrics (e.g., active users, usage frequency)
* Demonstrated client ROI and value realization
* Stakeholder relationship strength (including executive engagement)
* Volume and quality of consulting lead generation
* Sub-account / business-unit-level retention, in addition to aggregate portfolio retention, on accounts with multi-divisional structures

* **Client-focused mindset** with strong understanding of enterprise client needs
* **Commercial accountability** with experience owning revenue or renewal targets
* **Strategic thinking and analytical capability** to translate usage data into business value
* **Negotiation skills**, including experience working with procurement stakeholders
* **Executive presence** with ability to influence senior stakeholders
* **Strong discovery skills** to uncover client needs and growth opportunities
* **Collaborative approach** within cross-functional environments
* **Self-directed and accountable** for both client and commercial outcomes
* **Excellent communication skills**, adaptable across levels and regions
* **Technology and data fluency** to articulate insight-led value
* **Organizational agility** to manage relationships and priorities across multiple business units, regions, and buying centers within a single account

jobs.description:
**Honeycomb Insurance**

At Honeycomb, we're not just building technology; we're reshaping the future of insurance.

In 2025, Honeycomb was recognized by Dun & Bradstreet as "Top 10 Best Start Up Companies to Work For" in Israel, named by LinkedIn as "Top 10 Startups in Chicago", and Newsweek's "Greatest Startup Workplaces in America, 2025". Through the first half of 2026 we've been recognized on Inc. Magazine's "Best Workplaces" List and Forbes "Fintech 50".

How did we earn these honors?

Honeycomb is a rapidly growing global startup, generously backed by top-tier investors and powered by an exceptional team of thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers. Dual-headquartered in Chicago and Tel Aviv (R&D center), and with 6 offices across the U.S., we are reinventing the commercial real estate insurance industry, an industry long overdue for disruption. Just as importantly, we ensure every employee feels deeply connected to our mission and one another.

With over $100B in insured assets, Honeycomb operates across 23 states, covering more than 65% of the U.S. population and increasing its coverage.

If you're looking for a place where innovation is celebrated, culture actually means something, and smart people challenge you to be better every day - Honeycomb might be exactly what you've been looking for.

**What You'll Do**

As a Customer Success Representative (CSR), you'll be the first point of contact for our agents and policyholders - answering questions, resolving issues, and delivering a consistently positive experience across phone, email and chat. This is a phone-first role where you'll manage both call, email and chat queues throughout the day, so staying organized and on top of multiple channels is key.

But this isn't just a support role - it's a chance to be part of something being built in real time. Our CS team sits at the center of everything at Honeycomb, and the people in these seats today have a real opportunity to shape how we work, influence the processes we put in place, and leave a lasting mark on a company that has built a strong foundation and is now accelerating.

Respond to inbound calls and emails with timely, accurate, and professional service

* - phones are the priority.
* Build strong relationships with agents and customers through clear communication and consistent follow-through.
* Gather information needed to complete or revise quotes and keep open quote files up to date.
* Resolve service and billing inquiries or route them to the right internal team when needed.
* Keep detailed, accurate notes in HubSpot (our CRM) after every interaction.
* Spot patterns in customer or agent feedback and escalate product or process insights to the team.
* Support internal operations like producer login setups and agent onboarding.
* Guide agents and customers on how to use our tools and self-service options.
* Contribute to building and refining the processes and playbooks that will define how this team operates for years to come.
* Take on new tasks as the business grows and needs shift.

**Who Thrives Here**

Honeycomb is growing fast, and still writing parts of the playbook. If you've ever wanted to work somewhere where your ideas actually get heard and your fingerprints end up on how a company operates - this is that place. The people who do best here tend to share a few things in common:

* **You're comfortable with change.** Processes evolve, priorities shift, and not everything is fully defined yet. You adapt without getting bogged down.
* **You make informed calls with information.** You handle ambiguity well - you gather what you have, use good judgment, and move.
* **You're curious about insurance.** You don't need to be an expert on day one, but you want to understand how it works and get better at it over time.
* **You're tech-forward and AI-curious.** You pick up new tools quickly, you're not intimidated by systems, and you're genuinely interested in how AI is changing the way teams work.
* **You manage your workload well.** Whether you're on a call or working through emails, you stay on top of what needs attention and keep things moving.
* **You work well in a small team.** Everyone can see everyone's work here. You communicate openly, help when needed, and take ownership of your piece.

**Basic Requirements**

* 1+ years of experience in customer service, support, or an insurance-related role.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where tools and processes are still evolving.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks at once.
Experience with CRM tools* - HubSpot experience is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to listen actively, empathize, and de-escalate professionally.
* Hybrid availability: Must be able to work from our downtown Chicago office Tuesday through Thursday.

**Benefits**

* Base Salary: $55,000
* ISO stock options
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* HSA with company contributions
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible time off
* 10 company-paid holidays

* Monthly team events
* Free onsite gym membership

**Working at Ground Pros**

Founded in 1992, Ground Pros is a growing, family-owned and operated contractor specializing in commercial landscape and snow and ice management services. Our mission is to create raving fans by embodying our core values — People, Communication, Teamwork, Hustle and Ownership.

We are seeking an energetic, motivated and relationship-oriented Business Development Representative to play a high-impact role in driving the continued growth of Ground Pros. As a key face of our company, this individual will be responsible for building relationships with prospective clients, identifying new business opportunities and representing Ground Pros throughout the greater Chicagoland market.  
  
Reporting directly to the President, this position offers a unique opportunity to work closely with company leadership while developing the skills and experience necessary to become a successful business development professional. The ideal candidate will bring initiative, curiosity and a willingness to learn, with a focus on building lasting client relationships and contributing to Ground Pros' long-term success.

At Ground Pros, our careers include a competitive benefits and compensation package aimed at keeping you happy and healthy. From company-sponsored industry certifications to great benefits like health savings account (HSA) plans, paid parental leave and company matching retirement contributions, Ground Pros is an excellent place to grow your career.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

### **1. Build and Manage the Target Market**

* Develop and maintain a prioritized list of commercial properties and decision-makers that fit Ground Pros' targeted client profile
* Maintain accurate prospect and property information within Ground Pros' customer relationship management (CRM) software

**2. Generate and Qualify New Business Opportunities**

* Conduct outbound prospecting through calls, email, property visits, networking, referrals and industry events to build relationships with commercial property decision-makers
* Conduct discovery conversations and site walks to understand client needs, service expectations, decision criteria, timing, and current provider experience
* Partner with Estimator to coordinate property takeoffs, site measurements and estimating activities, ensuring timely progress toward proposal development

**3. Manage Follow-Up & Pipeline**

* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline within Ground Pros' CRM, including opportunity status, estimated value, client feedback, and clearly defined next steps.
* Proactively manage follow-up activities to advance opportunities through the sales process and address stalled prospects.

### **4. Prepare and Deliver Professional Proposals**

* Prepare and deliver professional proposals that clearly communicate scope, pricing and Ground Pros' value proposition
* Lead prospective clients through scope clarification, proposal review, negotiation and contract execution
* Coordinate leadership review when pricing exceptions, contractual issues or strategic decisions are required

### **5. Lead the Post-Sale Handoff**

* Conduct a formal handoff to Operations and Account Manager after contract execution
* Participate in client kickoff and initial transition activities when appropriate

### **6. Measure Performance and Communicate Results**

* Participate in weekly and quarterly pipeline and business development reviews with leadership to discuss sales activity, pipeline progress, results, opportunities and priorities

**Requirements – What's Needed to Succeed**
-------------------------------------------

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to initiate conversations, build relationships and represent Ground Pros professionally
* Self-motivated, energetic, and highly organized, with the discipline to consistently prospect, follow up and manage multiple opportunities
* Demonstrated curiosity, sound judgment, integrity and willingness to learn new skills, technologies, and business processes.

**Experience That Would Be Helpful**
------------------------------------

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, account management, hospitality or another relationship-oriented role
* Familiarity with commercial properties, property management or business-to-business service relationships
* Experience utilizing CRM software or other business technology

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Base Salary**:** 60,000–70,000 annually, based on qualifications and experience
* Commission & Incentives: Additional performance-based compensation opportunities tied to new business development, sales performance and company growth objectives
